youtube_title: Lost in a Forest: Keep Walking or Stay Put? Brave vs Normal #7 #Shorts
youtube_description:
BRAVE vs NORMAL - WHO'S RIGHT? #7. On a trek you lose your group and it's getting dark. Brave keeps walking to find the way. Normal stays put, tries 112 and keeps blowing a whistle. Who's right?
Answer: Normal. Search and rescue teams teach STOP - Stop, Think, Observe, Plan. If you keep moving, you get harder to find. Stay in one open spot, make yourself visible (bright clothes), make noise with a whistle, and save phone battery.
Source: search and rescue advice (B.C. AdventureSmart / BC Search and Rescue).
